name: skill-grader
description: AI Skill Grader, inside Codex. At the start of each session it gives a plain-English read on any skill it hasn't shown you yet — is it safe to run, and does it do what it says — using the same static run-safety engine as the site (no LLM, no network). It also blocks a manipulative skill's scripts from running. Ask for the full report on any skill.

interface.shortDescription: A plain-English run-safety read on every skill, before you rely on it.
